strategy.overview: Fun-Fest and Swinger are survival games with three drain-saving features. First raise the center post through either small up-post rollover and activate the left kickback from an outside top target. Then keep the ball high, taking a 3,000 top lane or a lit 5,000 center saucer when the cycle is favorable.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Fun-Fest or Swinger, raise the center post at either up-post rollover and light the left kickback by hitting an outside top target. Then keep shooting up the middle. Take a 3,000 top lane, or the center saucer when its 5,000 arrow is lit.
strategy.summary: Secure the center post and left kickback before chasing points. The two top lanes toggle between low and 3,000 values; the center saucer cycles through five states. Favor a safe top return over the unpredictable center swinging target.

quickInfo.name: Up-post rollovers
quickInfo.summary: Either small disk rollover beside the swinging target raises the center post.

quickInfo.name: Outside top targets
quickInfo.summary: Either marked outside target activates the left-side kickback.

quickInfo.name: Top lanes
quickInfo.summary: Their 3,000-point lamps toggle on and off with top switch activity.

quickInfo.name: Center saucer
quickInfo.summary: Scores 5,000 only when the orange arrow in its five-step cycle is lit.

steps.text: On the plunge, take a 3,000 top lane unless the center saucer is already at or near its 5,000 state.
Send the ball back up the middle until it crosses either small up-post rollover and raises the center post.
Nudge top action toward either outside standup to activate the left kickback.
With both protections active, keep the ball up top and favor a lit 3,000 lane or lit 5,000 saucer.
Avoid the center swinging target unless its current award justifies an unpredictable rebound.
Stay up top for lit lanes, bumpers, and favorable saucer awards.

machineSetup: Confirm whether the swing reel awards Extra Ball, replay, or points at four and six steps, and whether tournament settings disable either award.
Test both up-post rollovers and down-post switches, center post, outside top targets, left kickback, right gate, top-lane lamps, saucer cycle, and swinging-target feed.
